The ledger limits the integration merge to the audited original.

decisions.rationale: Stops and detaches invalid motor bindings and safely terminates PWM outputs; existing actuator configuration fields and workflows remain unchanged.
evidence: [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md): Electronic throttle and DC wastegate outputs stop immediately when disabled or when reinitialization fails.

[firmware/controllers/system/dc_motor.cpp](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/system/dc_motor.cpp): Replacement validation stops the previous motor binding and disabled slots detach cleanly.

[firmware/controllers/system/timer/pwm_generator_logic.cpp](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/system/timer/pwm_generator_logic.cpp): Software PWM terminal states are applied synchronously and forced STM32 output holds the inactive state.

last_sync.summary: Human-reviewed manual recovery audit for actuator inhibition across blocking burns. Source evidence is pinned at [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md); no new user setting or workflow requires a guide. The ledger limits the integration merge to the audited original.

decisions.rationale: Latches ETB and DC outputs off during blocking flash I/O until fresh feedback and a new control cycle; it changes safety behavior without a new user setting.
evidence: [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md): Blocking calibration burns inhibit electronic-throttle and DC wastegate outputs until fresh feedback and a new valid cycle.

[firmware/controllers/actuators/electronic_throttle.cpp](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/actuators/electronic_throttle.cpp): Burn gating stops configured ETB control and resumes only after newer valid sensor updates.

[firmware/controllers/sensors/core/sensor.h](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/sensors/core/sensor.h): Sensor timestamps carry freshness through stored, redundant and proxy providers.
